speaker: amari_ndlovu
headline: A BORDER DOES NOT END A HUMAN SYSTEM.
deck: People move through regional networks of family, work, care and survival even when institutions remain nationally bounded.
quote: The map that matters is not only the line between states. It is the route people must actually travel to remain whole.
facts: Care networks often cross formal jurisdictional boundaries.
Distance and documentation can turn nominal rights into practical exclusion.
Regional coordination can reduce duplicate barriers and lost cases.
Humanitarian continuity depends on recognising movement as part of ordinary life.
takeaway: Regional systems work when mobility does not erase continuity of care, rights or belonging.
